doc.parent.1:
If this field is absent, this advancement is a root advancement.
Circular references cause a loading failure.
doc.display.3: If present, advancement will be visible in the advancement tabs.
doc.criteria.5: If `requirements` is not defined, all defined criteria will be required.
doc.requirements.7:
If all criteria are required at once, this may be omitted.

Contains all of the `criteria` keys.

If all of the lists each have at least one criteria met, the advancement is complete (basically AND grouping of OR groups).
doc.rewards.9: Provided to the player when this advancement is obtained.
doc.sends_telemetry_event.11: Defaults to `false`. The vanilla game client only reads this for advancements from the `minecraft` namespace.
doc.trigger.13: Many triggers can occur multiple times, however, the reward will only be provided multiple times if the advancement is first revoked, which is often done within the function reward.
label.title: Title
doc.frame.18: Controls the advancement tile frame. Defaults to `task`.
doc.show_toast.20: Whether to show the toast pop up after completing this advancement. Defaults to `true`.
doc.announce_to_chat.22: Whether to announce in the chat when this advancement has been completed. Defaults to `true`.
doc.hidden.24:
Whether or not to hide this advancement and all its children from the advancement screen,
until this advancement have been completed.
Has no effect on root advancements themselves, but still affects all their children.
Defaults to `false`.
doc.function.34: Function to run as and at the player. Function tags are not allowed.
